text: With the earlier promise in mind, the difference is lessened. Isaac is still the child of the covenant, the one through whom the nations are to be blessed; yet God makes that very promise the matter of trial, and Abraham's answer is compressed into one word, _hineni_, "here I am," spoken three times, to God, to Isaac, and to the angel. It changes each time. It costs more each time, till presence itself has the form of loss, when Abraham says, "here I am," to the angel.
